structured.feedback: Meets most requirements: Markdown with subheadings, about 210 words, active voice, no links or invented quotes, a clear call to action, and no mention of the allergy or color complaints. Minor issues: "includes everything you need" and "Salon-quality results" slightly overpromise, and features are not clearly separated from benefits (the "Simple Application" section mixes process features with the bulleted benefits).
